newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Lace says plans third-party share allotment.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Lace says plans third-party share allotment.

text.p: Nippon Lace Co Ltd, a Japanese maker of lace, announced on Friday that it will conduct a third-party allotment of six million new shares.
The shares will be issued at 590 yen per share and the payment date is March 12, the company said in a statement.
The total value of the allotment is 3.54 billion yen.

The money raised through the new share offering will be used to strengthen the financial health of the company, which is expected to post an uncovered loss of 921 million yen in the financial year to March 1997, Nippon Lace said.
